result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority. I didn't add a test for your T-1 to T-5 example. The existing test suite passes (`mvn -q -o test`).

The change is in `DataStore.findOpenSupportTicketsOfCustomersInRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. It now uses the same `highestPriorityFirst()` ordering as the sales rep's open-ticket list, and I updated its comment to match. The filters are unchanged, so closed tickets and other regions' tickets stay out.

Only `RegionManagerService` calls this method, so nothing else changes order.
